construction.name: marked_pentagonal_prism_edge_dimer_return
construction.proof:
MARKED PENTAGON EDGE-DIMER RETURN

Let P be the canonical regular pentagonal prism and choose one actual
vertical side face. Its centroid m=(mx,my,0) is the radial midpoint of the
marked base edge. Put a complete copy of P at -m and its half-turn about
the prism axis at +m. Because the prism is symmetric in z, the second
copy is the central image -P. The marked edge face of the first and the
opposite marked edge face of the second now both lie in the plane
m dot x=0, with their interiors on opposite sides. This is one complete
two-owner module, with a retained common separator and marked source face.

The module is centrally symmetric and its rectangular bounding box is
computed from ALL vertices of BOTH owners. Treat that box as a whole cell
in the complete grid/row/layer constructions. The two owners and their
shared face are never independently repositioned. Deletion, if used for
an odd final count, removes a named whole owner and preserves its complete
parent module and cell.

The five actual side faces give five marked host registrations of this
same source operation. They form a finite exact list, not an angle sweep.
The source is classical edge gluing; no new infinite pentagon packing is
claimed. Every resulting finite witness must improve a pinned baseline
and pass native and independent complete geometry/decoder checks.
construction.native_decoder: Compute the exact centroid m of the marked canonical side face. In each centered module-grid cell place the canonical owner at -m and the z-half-turn owner at +m. Retain the listed whole-owner words; multiply every resulting center by1.0000001 and use nominal_s*1.0000001+1e-7, rounded upward.
